query:
SELECT os.id, os.qtdApInstalado, os.status, os.dataConclusao, os.updatedAt,
       e.inep, e.nome, e.qtdAp AS apPlanejado
FROM ordens_servico os
JOIN escolas e ON e.id = os.escolaId
WHERE e.inep = '29153670';
